title: An uncaught throw exits 1, which the vocabulary reads as VIOLATIONS
instrument: planted-crash test in scripts/tests/check-result.test.mjs asserting status 2 for sync/async/TypeError; census of tests that assert status 1 on a throw path
write_set: the 26 gate.mjs chain scripts (one-line opt-in each)
before: 3 planted crashes importing exit-codes: status 1,1,1; 56/81 scripts import exit-codes, 0 install a crash handler
fix: opt-in installCrashDoor() in exit-codes.mjs, called first by every chain script; census of throw-as-violation sites first

title: A literal exit(3) passes the contract without saying it means CONTENDED
instrument: planted literal-3 case in scripts/tests/check-exit-contract.test.mjs replacing the pin at lines 65-66
before: 8 literal-3 sites: 4 ledgered, 4 in run-board.mjs (450,660,705,719) unnamed; planted literal 3 -> exit 0
fix: any code above FATAL must be an EXIT name or ledgered collision; run-board's 4 sites become EXIT.CONTENDED

title: A hung gate step holds CI for six hours
instrument: seeded hanging step in a temp-tree gate test (check-result.test.mjs pattern)
before: spawnSync with no timeout; registry.yml no timeout-minutes
fix: per-step ceiling (~15 min) whose expiry is FATAL naming the step ('timed out'); optional timeout-minutes in registry.yml

title: context-map's population skips 5 tracked code files under references/
decision: are references/ executables (intake render-proof .py/.mjs, illustrate switcher-template.tsx; 972 LOC) swept code? if yes widen IN_SCOPE and claim them

title: apply-taxonomy breaks inbound links from outside the bundle and its post-check cannot see them
instrument: scripts/tests/apply-taxonomy.test.mjs: a fixture with docs/x.md and a second bundle linking into the moved subject; assert the dry run names both and --apply leaves 0 broken
before: 45 inbound links (1 cross-bundle, docs 11, librarian 33) neither rewritten nor checked; fileMap per bundle apply-taxonomy.mjs:159, post-check :307
fix: build inbound set from git ls-files *.md outside the bundle; rewrite through the round-trip invariant, or refuse with the list

title: 14 applications with a source: counterpart carry verified_against, which the reconcile brief forbids
decision: are the 14 external (drop verified_against: content change in knowledge/) or is the brief's rule wrong; and should an explicit external marker exist

title: catalog.json generatedAt is a frozen 2026-08-18 constant, not a generation time
decision: derive deterministically (newest commit date over hashed lanes / newest run row), rename, or remove - external consumers (Ascent, personas) read it

title: check-recipes runs no version discipline without --since, while check-skills checks the working tree against HEAD

note: changes gate --all behaviour for every session holding an unbumped dirty recipe
